title: Selection Reasons and Specifically Noted Features
summary: This topic centers on customers specifically highlighting reasons for selecting the vehicle or calling out individual features, but most examples do not provide enough context for a clear sentiment reading.

positive.summary: Positive feedback specifically praises the autopilot feature as a standout aspect the customer enjoys.

negative.summary: Negative feedback appears limited and is represented by a fragment about selecting the massage seat for back issues, which offers too little context to identify a clearer problem with the vehicle itself.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention selection reasons, size, sound options, app capabilities, or partial phrases, but they are too fragmentary or ambiguous for reliable sentiment classification.

limitations: Most examples are short or fragmentary, so sentiment and intent are often unclear.
The cluster mixes several unrelated subjects, including purchase reasons, feature selection, vehicle size, and app functionality.
Some fragments reference other vehicles or incomplete phrases, limiting topic coherence and interpretation.
